Overview

EduQuest is a mentorship platform that connects mentors and mentees in educational institutions, addressing the challenges of informal communication.

It offers a dedicated space for structured mentorship, with clear communication channels, efficient scheduling, and organized resource sharing.

Process

Define

Problem Statement

Mentors face challenges managing time and balancing professional and personal boundaries due to informal communication methods. Mentees, on the other hand, experience delays in responses, difficulty reaching out after class hours, and discomfort using social media for academic purposes. EduQuest aims to provide a structured and user-friendly platform that facilitates seamless and professional interaction, ensuring efficient and effective mentorship.

Understanding user perspectives

To gain a clear understanding of the mentorship challenges, we conducted interviews with 5 mentees and 2 mentors, along with surveys that gathered responses from 14 mentees and 7 mentors.

The research revealed that mentors struggled with time management, maintaining professional boundaries, and handling multiple mentees across various informal channels. Mentees reported delays in responses, discomfort using social media for academic queries, and difficulty in getting clear, timely answers.

"I sometimes have to wait a long time for a reply, and it’s frustrating when I need help quickly."
"It’s hard to manage dedicated time for mentees because they reach out on Facebook or Viber, and it often invades my personal space."
"It feels awkward to reach out to mentors on social media, and I worry about disturbing them after class hours."
"I need a proper platform where mentees can reach out during office hours, so I can separate my work and personal life"
"I rarely approach mentors who aren’t my course instructors because I don’t know them well, but I would if there was an easier way."
"Managing a large number of mentees is overwhelming, especially when they all ask questions at different times on different platforms"

Market Research Analysis

We conducted a SWOT analysis of prominent existing institutions to gain insights into their strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats, informing our strategy for EduQuest.

The secondary research conducted for EduQuest revealed several insights into the current landscape of mentorship in educational settings:

Visibility

Most platforms display mentor bios only after users log in and apply, limiting access to information. EduQuest can improve user experience by providing clear mentor profiles upfront, showcasing areas of expertise and relevant backgrounds.

Communication Method

Existing platforms utilize various communication methods, including video, phone, and email. EduQuest should incorporate a seamless communication interface, enhancing interaction between mentors and mentees

Functionality

Some platforms offer search filters based on skills and mentoring types, while others lack structured filtering

Focus Areas

Current platforms cover diverse fields, including business and STEM.

User empathy

After I had a better understanding of my users and their needs, I designated personas types to guide design decision. Our persona hypothesis consisted of 2 archetypes which I made sure I keep checking in them at every milestone. I also identified two use case scenarios that strongly resonate with my personas.

Structuring the experience with mental models

Building upon the research insights and brainstorming, I identified user tasks, organized them into content and features. I considered user activities and opportunities, then structured these insights into a sitemap, aligning with personas, technical constraints, and business goals.

Hi-fi Designs

After analysing the feedback from the testing session, I focused on creating more detailed and refined designs. I paid close attention to things like colours, typography, and overall visuals to create a polished user interface.

The onboarding process is designed to be welcoming and informative. New users are guided through a series of steps that help them set up their profiles, outline their goals, and explore the platform's features

Profile Setup

Easy-to-use forms for entering personal information, professional background, and specific mentorship interests.

Top Mentors

A curated list of the most recommended mentors based on the user's interests and previous interactions. Users can quickly access mentor profiles and set up meetings from this section. Top Courses: Featured courses and learning materials relevant to the mentee's goals and interests. This section provides quick access to resources that can enhance their skills and knowledge.

Set Up Meetings

Easily schedule sessions with their mentors by selecting available time slots. The calendar syncs with the mentors' availability, providing a seamless booking experience. View Appointments: Users can view all their upcoming and past sessions in a clear, organized manner. Color-coded indicators help differentiate between upcoming, completed, and pending sessions.

Search and Filters

A robust search function with filters for industry, skills, experience, availability, and more. This helps users narrow down their options and find the most suitable mentor. Mentor Profiles: Detailed profiles for each mentor, including their background, expertise, testimonials, and availability. Users can view mentor ratings and reviews to make informed decisions.
